status: four source-validated findings; no fixes included in this review

findings.title: Persistent music errors are retried and toasted on ordinary/repeated field gestures
findings.reason: soundUnlocked branch retries whenever musicError or pending restore exists after prior request settles; all noneditable keydowns including repeat call it, and each current request failure unconditionally toasts. Offline/unsupported cue remains a reachable error even after future asset export. Uncommitted-catalog absence itself is not treated as approval or an extra source finding.
findings.meaningfulRegression: Persistent playMap rejection through actual key handler, including repeat; bound retries and toast repetition while preserving explicit Settings recovery.

findings.title: Unbounded audio I/O is awaited while battleSoundOwned locks the field
findings.reason: No preparation or restore bound exists; catalog/session fetch/decode and prior pending restores are awaited before gameplay, and new-map restore decode is awaited before owner release. Abort is reached only after action exits, so a stalled pre-action fetch has no caller that can abort it. Existing field locks work as designed but therefore become unbounded.
findings.meaningfulRegression: Never-settling catalog/fetch/decode port under a fake clock must reach silent battle and release postbattle field ownership within a source-host bound; late completions must not start stale cues.

findings.title: Initial menu focus selects heading Back instead of a useful action
findings.reason: Every new panel autofocuses its first enabled control; rich menu heading Back precedes content. Confirm immediately selects Back. Baseline first button was the first actual menu entry.
findings.meaningfulRegression: Actual menu + UI class, flush owned focus timer then confirm; initial action should be an appropriate menu tile or selected pocket, not accidental Back.

findings.status: validated-source; native browser default activation not executed
findings.title: Returning focus to HUD Menu combines with unprevented field Enter to reopen it
findings.reason: Closing a HUD-opened menu restores the connected HUD button, whereas baseline focused the canvas. Enter invokes interact without preventDefault and retains the button default activation; if interaction consumes no scene, HUD onclick can open the menu again. Browser/device execution is not claimed.
findings.meaningfulRegression: Open/close from actual HUD opener, then field Enter; prevent duplicate default activation or restore field canvas focus.
